title: Three Intent Realms
summary: At the Baiyun Sect the old man pins a mid Nascent Soul Wang Lin in place so he can feel the Soul Formation elders' Intent Realms as they attack. Wen Baoxin's realm is detachment, cutting off joy, anger, love and hatred; Shi Qi's is a lazy, drowsy realm that almost traps Wang Lin until his killing-energy pearl wakes him; and Qing Song's is age, which drains spiritual power and ages the body. The old man pays the sect with an Ancestral Spirit Token, one of many tokens he carries from other sects, and takes Wang Lin home. Seventeen years later Wang Lin is an old shopkeeper who owns much of the old street, Daniu has a son, Zeng Xiaoniu, and Wang Lin still cannot find his own Intent Realm. One night Baiyun disciple Yi Fu chases Xu Tao into the street, and when he tries to kill Wang Lin as well, Wang Lin destroys his natal Rakshasa; Yi Fu flees, badly hurt, to his master Zhou Wutai.

cultivation: Wang Lin: mid Nascent Soul. Shi Qi and Qing Song: Soul Formation. Yi Fu: Foundation Establishment. Zhou Wutai: late Nascent Soul.
